<div class="card-body">
'''Echo Trooper Backpack''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">エコー兵員用バックパック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の兵員／トルーパーに配備する。兵器やアイテムをいくつでも持ち歩き、使用できるようになる。兵員／トルーパーは惑星位置において耐：損耗＜３を得る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Echo-Trooper-Backpack-PSA-156433115.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の兵士は多種多様な敵や環境に対応できるよう、さまざまな装備を持ち歩いている。全天候型のバックパックは機材を周囲の環境から守ってくれる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Echo trooper backpack.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any trooper. May carry and use any number of weapons and devices. The trooper is immune to attrition < 3 at planet locations.

'''Lore:'''
Rebel soldiers carry a variety of gear so they can face many enemies and environments. An all-weather backpack keeps equipment safe from the surroundings.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Echo Trooper Backpack]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
